outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart of Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models, showing mean ± SD bars with individual biological replicate data points (colored dots) overlaid for each group (RPR2, RPM, SNL, LP, SL, KP).
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating the Ad-Cre tumor induction workflow, not a data plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C shows representative MRI images, not a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D consists of representative H&E micrographs, not a summary plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel E shows H&E and RNAscope images of lung sections, not a quantitative plot with averages.
Panel F shows representative micrograph images (H&E and RNAscope) comparing squamous tumors and normal lung, not a summary plot.
Panel G shows an H&E image with RNAscope staining for Tmprss11b and Sox2, not a quantitative summary plot.
